instagram.caption:
The offcut that is still good wood.
The Material Rack in the Workshop. Hold the wood and metal you will genuinely use, stored so it stays straight and does not fall on anyone.

What done looks like:
1. Boards lying flat
2. Supported along their length with the longest
3. Heaviest at the bottom
4. Sheet goods standing on edge against the wall rather than leaning out into the room

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success material rack.
